blurb: A museum of the first atomic bombing, by the ruined dome that still stands.

facts.t: An American bomber dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima. Around 140,000 people had died by the end of that year. The museum keeps the belongings of the dead, and asks that it never happen again.

src.n: Wikipedia: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki

facts.t: The Industrial Promotion Hall stood almost directly below the explosion, and its dome frame survived. It has been kept exactly as it was, and is a World Heritage Site.
